claims.text: Montage Laguna Beach sits on a coastal bluff above the Pacific.

findings.quote: Perched on a coastal bluff above the Pacific

claims.text: The property is designed to resemble a California Craftsman-style village.

findings.quote: Designed to resemble a California Craftsman-style village

claims.text: Artwork in the rooms highlights local artists and scenes from Laguna Beach.

findings.quote: Artwork throughout the rooms highlights local artists and scenes from Laguna Beach

claims.text: Dining includes Studio Mediterranean, The Loft, Mosaic Bar and Grille by the pool, and the Lobby Lounge.

findings.quote: Delight in coastal Mediterranean cuisine at Studio Mediterranean, creative American flavors at The Loft, casual beach fare poolside at Mosaic Bar and Grille or a curated selection of beverages at Lobby Lounge.
findings.note: all four outlets named, Mosaic poolside

claims.text: The Studio Mediterranean menu draws on Mediterranean and Greek traditions with seasonal ingredients from California farms.

findings.quote: The menu draws inspiration from Mediterranean and Greek traditions, with a strong emphasis on seasonal ingredients sourced from California farms.

claims.text: Spa Montage is a 20,000-square-foot indoor-outdoor facility.
